risk_addressed: The last-mile checklist named private signature but did not give the operator a compact proof checklist for identity, role, branch value, expiry, and storage hash. This public template makes missing authority explicit without exposing private identity material.
required_private_fields_not_in_public_re: operator legal/person name or agreed pseudonymous authority handle
operator role and authority basis for the archive action
branch value: NO-SEND / DEFER / STOP / ONE-SHOT-REVIEWER-FIRST-SEND
sender account binding if ONE-SHOT-REVIEWER-FIRST-SEND is chosen
exact subject, recipient, body hash, .eml hash, no-attachment scope, and one-shot limit
private record storage location and signature record SHA-256
affirmation that route facts and hashes will be recomputed at send time
fail_closed_rule: If any required private field is missing, expired, or inconsistent with route/hash/root records, the action result is NO-SEND until a new private authority record is created.
